resolvedFindings.RE-058-001: Exact completed + terminal archive + matching PASS Result is recognized before generic non-active blocking; active archive PASS and all other non-active shapes fail closed.
resolvedFindings.RE-058-002: Policy computes normal boundary first, validates reported nextBoundary against normal, then applies matching bounded Owner revise correction.
resolvedFindings.RE-058-003: 42/42 history is limited to ordering evidence; legal-boundary calculation is explicitly separated from external invocation and durable OwnerAuthorityFact semantics.

decisions: Policy computes legal boundary only; actual host invocation is a separate concern and is not implied by READY(action).
Exact completed + terminal archive + matching PASS Result is the only post-archive exception to generic non-active blocking and yields checkpoint-evaluation.
Active + terminal archive + PASS is blocked until Change materialization is completed.
Reported nextBoundary consistency is evaluated against the deterministic normal boundary before optional Owner correction.
Owner correction remains revise-only, stage-bounded, requires matching explicit OwnerAuthorityFact, and cannot hide a conflicting reported boundary.
Normal ordering does not require Policy to create or consume fresh authorize-apply/archive Owner facts; external invocation semantics remain outside this Change.
Policy outcome vocabulary uses canonical RunResultRecord authorConclusion/reviewerVerdict semantics rather than legacy external wire field names.
